tweet.text: We reviewed a section of Anthropic’s February 2026 Risk Report focused on automated R&D risk from Opus 4.6. While we take issue with the adequacy of evidence the report provides, we agree with Anthropic about the overall level of risk & remain excited to pilot reviews like these.
